title: 718. Random Pick with Blacklist

examples.explanation: Valid numbers are 0, 1, 4 and 6. Each draw value is wrapped into that set; with tail remapping the four draws land on 0, 1, 6 and 4.
Valid numbers are 0, 1 and 3. The third draw maps past the blocked value 2 onto 3.
Only 0 is available, so every draw returns 0.

hints: Let sz = n - blacklist.length. Remap every blocked value below sz to a free value from the tail; wrapping each draw with a non-negative modulo gives an index in [0, sz).
Build a hash set of blocked values, then assign tail replacements from n-1 downward skipping blocked entries.

Adaptation: calls stands in for random draws so the task is deterministic. The checker only verifies that each answer lies in range and avoids the blacklist; any valid pick is accepted. Rust note: vectors arrive as usual integer lists.
